store.summary: Pocket pixel-art virtual pet RPG with 35 evolutions, battles & 8-bit audio
store.description: Raise one of 5 customizable pixel-art companions on your Cardputer Zero with 7 coat colors, a clock-synced bedroom window, and a casual 48-hour survival rule. Shape 35 Baby, Teen, and Adult evolutions across Radiant, Trained, and Wild care paths through daily care, Star Catch, and Teach stat drills. Challenge wild Z-Pets and 5-win Elite Bosses in the turn-based Battle Arena to unlock and upgrade a sparkling Boss Crown shelf trophy. Features a built-in 48 kHz mono procedural 8-bit soundtrack, 4-tier SFX/Music volume settings, and live fn+A/S/D hardware volume controls.
